Maxima and fixed order statistics are1-Lipschitz in the vector sup norm. Input error h plus rounding error<=h gives final price error<=2h and sale error<=2Kh<=epsilon/2. Oracle operation and precision claims remain separated.

Directly compared all bundle objectives in the two-clause XOS example: prices(5,2,2) demand{b,c}; prices(5,6,2) demand{a} uniformly on Z_g in(0,.1). Every fixed-price distinct-bundle tie is a nonconstant affine equation in independent continuous noise, so genericity holds and sale(c) drops1->0 when only p_b increases.
